audit.why: 49.55% over 111 games. Gangplank owns 2-3 and both item stages; Aurora's window is 4-6, before Cannon Barrage and before his barrel chains scale. Powder Keg reaches 1000 units against Twofold Hex's 900, so he can chip you without ever entering your range — that is why the early stages sit with him.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 phase named her ultimate "Between the Worlds" and did not say what Cannon Barrage changes.
audit.why: Cannon Barrage is 160/140/120 seconds at 30000 range — it is global, so his level 6 is a map spike that hits other lanes, not a lane all-in you have to survive. Between Worlds is 140s, shorter than his at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Between Worlds (R, 140s) is your all-in. Cannon Barrage is 160s and global — his 6 hits other lanes, not yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text, wants.you[1], mid and whys[4] all build the level-6 plan around Aurora going untargetable in "spirit mode". Across the Veil grants invisibility; Between Worlds grants a slow zone and a cross-zone teleport. Neither grants untargetability, and the page treats it as the reason the all-in works.
audit.why: The interaction that actually decides this lane is already half-stated and worth stating properly: Remove Scurvy (W, 22/20/18/16/14, 400) 'eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health' — it cleanses The Weirding's slow and heals him in the same cast, so every commit you make into an available Remove Scurvy is a wasted commit and a wasted 15s E. At 22 seconds at rank 1 it is the longest cooldown in his kit and the only real window. Powder Keg (E) is placed at 1000 range and detonated by his attack, spreading that attack's damage and slowing — so the counter is to break line of sight to the kegs or kill them, not to out-trade the explosion. Parrrley (Q, 4.5s, 625) is his chip and it is never down.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy cleanses your E slow and heals him — commit only inside its 22s downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked cooldown is "Powder Kegs", which has no cooldown to track — the kit file records it as 0 because kegs are charge-based.
audit.why: Telling a player to engage 'on Powder Kegs's cooldown' is unfollowable. Remove Scurvy at 22s is the cooldown that decides whether your commit lands.
audit.corrected: Kegs are charge-based, not on a cooldown — count Remove Scurvy (22s) instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal line despite Remove Scurvy being flagged as his sustain.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy restores health on a 22s cycle; Grievous Wounds is what stops that cleanse-plus-heal from resetting your whole poke phase.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb answers Remove Scurvy's heal — the cleanse you cannot buy around, the heal you can.
